usedFor: Pitchit holds lead insights, and Salesforce receives a contact when “When a lead's insights are updated” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a lead's insights are updated” in Pitchit, then “Create Contact” in Salesforce
bestTemplate.why: Once a lead has fresh insights, a Salesforce contact is created so sales sees them in the CRM.

watchOut: That trigger fires on every update to a lead's insights, so “Create Contact” can add the same person twice.
